lines.text: Did you know? Fer is Latin for carry.
Quick quiz! Which means before plus carry?

words.ex: I'll transfer the money to your account today.
Please refer to page ten for more details.

publish.title: Fer root: transfer, refer and prefer
publish.value: Fer comes from Latin "ferre" (to carry, to bring). Words: transfer, refer and prefer. transfer = trans + fer; refer = re + fer; prefer = pre + fer.
